query: How many organisations are currently listed as signatories on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory page (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/ai-code-practice) as of July 2026? List the count and names if possible.
answer:
I've completed the research. **Summary:** The official EU Commission signatory page lists **23 organisations** as of July 2026 — **22 that signed all three chapters** (Accexible, AI Studio Delta, Aleph Alpha, Almawave, Amazon, Anthropic, Black Forest Labs, Bria AI, Cohere, Domyn, Dweve, Fastweb, IBM, Lawise, LINAGORA, Microsoft, Mistral AI, Open Hippo, OpenAI, Pleias, ServiceNow, WRITER) plus **xAI**, which signed only the Safety and Security chapter.

Key caveats flagged in my report: the list is continuously updated (so the count is a moving target); August 2025 press reported "~26" companies; and Google/DeepMind was reported by press as a signatory but did not appear in the fetched official list, suggesting the extraction may reflect a partial/cached snapshot and the true current figure could be slightly higher (mid-20s).
